description: Creates an auto-layout container frame (layout primitive) — the fallback when NO DS component exists for a section or layout. Every fill/padding/gap/radius binds to DS variables; component-like names are gated (pass confirmedNoComponent + primitiveOverrideReason for confirmed gaps). Name frames after their HTML role ("Header Section", "Card: Revenue"). Key params: parentId (omit for page-level artboard), direction, layoutSizing*, *Variable bindings, GRID mode. Check mimic_map_components FIRST. Phase 2+.

confirmedNoComponent.description: Set true only after DS/library search confirms no component exists for this role.

cornerRadius.description: Raw corner radius in pixels. Use cornerRadiusVariable when DS has radius variables.

cornerRadiusVariable.description: DS variable path for corner radius.

direction.description: Auto-layout direction. Prefer HORIZONTAL or VERTICAL — NONE breaks portability. Use layoutPositioning ABSOLUTE for overlay children instead.

fill.description: Raw hex color for background fill (e.g. "#ffffff"). Fallback when no DS styles/variables.

fillStyleId.description: DS fill style key for background (from figma_list_ds (kind: "fill_styles")). Preferred over fillVariable when DS has fill styles but no variables.

fillVariable.description: DS variable path for background fill.

gap.description: Raw item spacing in pixels. Use gapVariable when DS has spacing variables.

gapVariable.description: DS variable path for item spacing.

gridColumnCount.description: Number of grid columns. Only used when layoutMode is GRID.

gridColumnGap.description: Raw column gap in pixels. Only used when layoutMode is GRID.

gridColumnGapVariable.description: DS spacing variable path for GRID column gap.

gridColumnSpan.description: When this frame is a child of a GRID-layoutMode parent, how many columns it should span.

gridRowCount.description: Number of grid rows. Only used when layoutMode is GRID.

gridRowGap.description: Raw row gap in pixels. Only used when layoutMode is GRID.

gridRowGapVariable.description: DS spacing variable path for GRID row gap.

gridRowSpan.description: When this frame is a child of a GRID-layoutMode parent, how many rows it should span.

layoutMode.description: Set to GRID to use CSS-grid-style layout (Grid automation, May 2026) instead of auto-layout. Requires gridRowCount/gridColumnCount. Errors clearly on Figma versions that do not support GRID layoutMode — fall back to direction HORIZONTAL/VERTICAL in that case.

layoutPositioning.description: Set to ABSOLUTE to position this frame as an overlay inside an auto-layout parent (out of flow but still contained). Use for grid lines, positioned labels, etc.

name.description: Semantic name describing the HTML role (e.g., "Header Section", "Metrics Row", "Card: Revenue"). Never use generic names like "Frame".

padding.description: Raw uniform padding in pixels. Use paddingVariable when DS has spacing variables.

paddingBottomVariable.description: DS variable path for bottom padding.

paddingLeftVariable.description: DS variable path for left padding.

paddingRightVariable.description: DS variable path for right padding.

paddingTopVariable.description: DS variable path for top padding.

paddingVariable.description: DS variable path for uniform padding.

parentId.description: Parent node ID. Omit for page-level.

primitiveOverrideReason.description: Required with confirmedNoComponent for component-like primitives. Explain why this frame must be custom.

stroke.description: Raw hex color for stroke (e.g. "#e4e6ee"). Fallback when no DS stroke variables.

strokeVariable.description: DS variable path for stroke color.

x.description: X position in pixels. Required for page-level artboards. Use rightmost existing artboard x + width + 80.

y.description: Y position in pixels. Defaults to 0 for artboards.

name: figma_create_frame
